notes.title: Patch notes 0.76 and 0.77
notes.notes:
Uhhh so someone forgot to post patch notes for patch 0.76…If you ask me whose fault it is. I will enact my 5th amendment right to remain silent as to not self incriminate. (I'm greek I have no idea if this is correct but that's what I remember for Law&Order)


Onto the good stuff!


[h1]Patch 0.76 (went live a week ago)[/h1]

-Full auto, Anything to Survive, & Blood Brothers loadouts updated:
Cover and description added
Unique characters added
First legendary weapon added! (Natasha’s ‘Beast’ in the Full Auto loadout)

[h3]-Leaderboard[/h3]
We overhauled the leaderboard showing some informative and funny stats for each run.

[h3]-Options menu[/h3]
Overhaul of the options menu to bring it inline with the new UI style and added a few more options, but there's more still to come.

[h3]-Turret damage effects[/h3]
To make it clearer which turrets are damaged and by how much we added some effects to them, Sparks 60% hp, Smoke 40% hp, and Fire 20% hp. 

[h3]-Boink[/h3]
Just right click on some stuff ingame, dead bodys, bugs, weapons, some bits of trash around the map(but not all) and have fun.

[h3]-Boink Golf[/h3]
This is now my favorite pastime outside of making horrible art. Using the boink system to try and launch weapons across the map so they land in the center. (you can pause the game, and boink an object multiple times to add additional force, you can also boink it from different directions and all forces are added together when you unpause.)

[h3]-Introduce a lot of bugs...[/h3]
shhhhhh it [i]never happened[/i], keep on reading.


[h1]And now for Patch 0.77![/h1]

[h3]-Maintenance mode[/h3]
Activated by pressing ALT or clicking on the maintenance mode button in the top left. Maintenance mode is designed to make it easier to maintain and repair your buildables. It includes:
HP colored outlines for all buildables
Show all turret ranges
Repair all button
Repair all turrets button
“One-click repair” mode, where any buildable you click on is set to repair (combos very nicely with HP outlines)

[h3]-New Buildable Card[/h3]
Updated the UI that shows up when you click on a buildable showing some important stats, as well as giving the option to destroy or repair.

[h3]-Overhaul to character speech bubbles[/h3]
Character conversations now autoplay, however the bubbles are a lot smaller and less intrusive, hovering over a bubble pauses it so you can read it, and clicking advances to the next line.

[h3]-Character thought bubbles[/h3]
Whenever a crew member changes stance, a thought bubble will pop up showing what they are doing now, this helps inform the player of what their idiots are thinking.

[h3]-broken weapon warning[/h3]
We added a special warning into the thought bubbles which is a broken weapon icon so in the heat of battle it's easier to tell if someone's weapon just broke.

[h3]-Fix the bugs we introduced in 0.76...[/h3]
see, told you. [i]it never happened[/i] ಠ_ರೃ

As always, Enjoy the dumbsterfire
Nick

notes.title: Patch #0.75 new UI + RNGesus game mode improvements
notes.notes:
This has been a fairly major patch as it overalls our entire UI, which was tied into basically all of the game functionality. There are still some elements of the UI left to finish but we wanted to get this patch out because it also[b] fixes a long list of bugs[/b] people had found.

Loren and I (Nick) also added more dad jokes, because that's why you are all here, let's be honest.

[u][b]New UI:[/b][/u]
We have overhauled the UI to make it more functional and more stylized. We have also integrated a lot of player feedback in regards to showing more stats and information about how weapons and buildables work. This overhaul also included improvements to the pausing mechanics, which we have now creatively named “Planning mode”. Although it probably should be “shit I need to piss” mode. 

[u][b]- RNGesus game mode improvements:[/b][/u] (both endless and survival are now considered “RNGesus” modes this is to help differentiate between them and the full story mode which is coming soon.)

[u][b]- Lolita loadout:[/b][/u]
Improved version of “one man army” mode including a custom character, and cover art.

[u][b]- Sinful 6 loadout:[/b][/u]
Improved version of “Manpower” mode including custom characters, and cover art.

There are a lot of other fixes and tweaks but honestly I can't remember them, my main focus was maining the Ballmer peak ([url=https://xkcd.com/323/]https://xkcd.com/323/[/url]) not documenting stuff.

OH! P.S. Loren fixed that bug where rations were insanely rare early game in endless mode making it almost unplayable. That was a beautiful bug mixing My superhuman stupidity and Lorens laziness. Removing that bug was like killing a little fucked up baby of ours :(

notes.title: Patch #0.74 new game mode + map!
notes.notes:
It's been a fairly crazy 2 weeks, as we are deep in the development of the upcoming story mode, (if you want to know more or see some WIPS of the custom illustrated comic telling the Adventures of Andy and Heather, check out our discord! https://discord.gg/nkzQ4rC )

However, despite that, we still got another update for you! With an entirely new gamemode as well as kickass new map!

You will notice some features are halfway there, like the new game mode selection. It still has placeholder visuals and some buttons exist but do nothing, like Story Mode as it is still in development. So we appreciate your patience and understanding. 

However if you are not patient or understanding you can keep your feelings to yourself.

As always any and all feedback is appreciated, and keep killing bugs! (or yelling at Nick, both avenues for success in life)

Added functionality:
Each game mode has its own save file! If you're having a rough time in your Full Auto game, feel free to start with a different loadout
Sweet new main menu with cool movie buttons. Watch the game before you play the game!

Added content:
Sweet new loadout selection screen! Scroll through your comics and select the one you want to play
New menu when clicking a character's portrait. No more mouse jumping to the middle of your screen and opening a radial menu! Huzzah!

Quality of life changes:
Send Wave button moved up near the round timer for easy-of-discovery.
Weapon Card restructured. Not sure if it's better, but it's different! Everyone loves different!
Give Weapon button moved to underneath the comparison card on the weapon assignment UI. Maybe it'll be clear you're supposed to compare them if it's down there?

Balancing changes
Master Looter / Looter now have a chance to grant bonus resources when finding bolts/wires/rations.
End of wave message now allows you to see top menu bar so you can assess if you have enough rations to leave


Bugfixes: 
Floating text doesn't persist when maps change. Most noticeable when people in your team are healed between maps.
Radial menu would have problems clicking on Search when Heal was enabled.
Destroyed objects don't persist when maps change either. Oops.
Switching loadouts without closing the game could cause buggy behaviour. I mean, it used to. But I fixed that.
Main Menu is now destroyed instead of hidden. Small performance increase for those potatoes out there.
Nick is a doodoo head

notes.title: Patch #0.73 New maps!
notes.notes:
Soooo I forgot to post the patch notes of everything we did last week... meh bad. so this one is super long, encompassing everything we have updated over the last 2 weeks.

As always, we welcome any and all feedback! 

If you want to see us working live, and get a sneak peek on the new maps I'm working on, hop over to our discord!

Added functionality:
Weapon cards now display on screen for weapons you find. Dismiss them if you'd like.
Turrets now display their range when you are placing them
Weapons can be scrapped now! Get some small amount of resources for all those Tier1 weapons littering the ground.
Starting loadouts now show what I think their difficulty is. You may have different opinions. If so, come share your voice on our discord.
Clicking on a portrait centers the screen on that character, moves your mouse to the center, and opens their radial UI. No more ugly radial UIs showing up at the edge of your screen for crewmember 8 and 9. This change has caused heartache amongst the people, and we don't know how to solve it. Help us!
Setting a building to be repaired automatically assigns the closest crewmember to build status.

Added content:
New maps! Try to spot the battlecruiser, the pier (rework), the SETL headquarters, and (my personal favorite) the exotic dancer club! Unfortunately, Nick hates our old maps, so we're down to just 6 maps for this patch. He's working hard on more, though.
Sweet new stats are tracked and displayed. This may kill any existing saves. My bad, yo. :X
Becoming angelic is reflected in game now. Poorly, but still. Same with poorly animated, although that is reflected poorly on purpose.
New quirks! Watch out for tinkerers and engineers who will make your repairs cheaper. Also, inventors who will build defenses instantly.

Balancing changes
Sending a wave early secures you additional points. Woo! Points!
Assigning people to jobs works .. different ... now. I think it's better, but you be the judge.
Simon is a weakling, and so has been reduced in number on the second wave. May Steve reign supreme.
Melee weapons have had their damage numbers updated. Hammer is still king of damage, but the Axe needed improvement.
Repairing has been changed in how much it costs


Bugfixes: 
Picking up a melee weapon won't switch to it if you already have a ranged weapon. Was this a bug? I dunno, I have no idea what other category it goes in.
Character dialog is suppressed when the options menu is opened
Sometimes, a specific dialog option would hork and kill the dialog system. This has been fixed. The person responsible for designing the dialog system has been sacked.
Characters don't ice skate anymore. It has been determined that Dick (lol) was the figureskating world champion of the SRIS universe, and so the competition has ended.
Characters no longer snap to aim at their targets.
Characters no longer aim at their targets while moving into range.
Gaining a buildable will no longer make you regret your life if you save and exit, then immediately start a new game.
Your save file now tracks historical information of what maps you've been on and what intros you've encountered
Nick licks butts

notes.title: Patch #0.72...
notes.notes:
Soo….. we ended up making way more updates way more often then I was planning on, so some orderly patch note system went out the window.

I'm going to call this patch 0.72, because why not but actually its 12+ patches we have been doing over the past week. 

As always, we welcome any and all feedback! 

If you want to see us working live, and get a sneak peek on the total map rework I'm doing now, hop over to our discord!

[h2]Added functionality:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards are in! We'll record your best high score, the highest wave reached, and the total number of waves completed. Slap those numbers up on a board and compete with the community!
[*] Health bar now flashes when taking damage. Easily see which of your crew are the most (brain) damaged!
[*] Score Multiplier! As you get farther into a map, your score potential goes up and up and up! Until you die or move to the next map.
[*] Click on the character portrait and the radial menu comes up. Wooo! Thanks, @Shawnaroo, for keeping this on our radar.
[*] Options menu can now be accessed from inside the game! Woooooo exciting!
[*] Tooltips can now be disabled inside the options menu
[*] Characters now parry incoming attacks when equipped with a melee weapon. The T5 sword maybe OP.
[*] The buildable now comes with its own permanently displayed tooltip where it thinks about how to place it and our failures as developers.
[*] Quirks are now coloured according to their functionality! Green = good, red = bad, black = no effect. Look for the light blue, as it is super mysterious and rare.
[*] Gary the Decoy's hands now flash with a speed proportional to his health total. The closer he is to a tragic end, the faster they blink.
[/list]

[h2]Added content:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cool leaderboard screen where you can see how you stack up against the other SRIS community members.
[*] Sweet new map! Start your game off on the street corner, where Nick spends most his time these days. 
[*] Weapon stat block now shows in the character bio UI. Look at all the pretty numbers! Don't forget to check the hover over tooltips if you're confused as to what they mean.
[*] Rework of the "Parked Fighter Squadron" map - now upgraded with death, destruction, and more than a little blood. Pay attention to the details to try to discover the full story!
[*] Options screen can now be accessed from within the pause menu! Woo, you can change the volume while playing a game!
[*] You can click the "Search Me" box on slot machines to get your crew searching faster. Same functionality as "Everyone, Search" button.
[/list]
[h2]
Balancing changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ramped up difficulty between hours and between maps
[*] Assault Rifle Turret was nerfed a bit too hard. He has been buffed
[*] Minigun was also buffed to make sure he's still better to justify his increased cost
[*] Boss Steve had his hp toned down a bit. He may have been TOO crazy
[*] The "developer mistake" map was causing too much testing feedback, so it's been pushed back far enough in the rotation that people should get the joke. Or not, some people are oblivious.
[*] New maps are shunted to front of the list to make sure that testing feedback incorporates our new changes
[/list]


[h2]Bugfixes: [/h2]
[list]
[*] Slot Machine "Search Me" tooltip stops displaying on its death
[*] Character health bars now show black for max health that will never come back
[*] Radial menus will close when a character dies
[*] Filling your team up with a story event doesn't murder the game anymore
[*] Bringing up a radial menu will disallow buildings from showing their hp. Mainly useful when your dude is in a Covered Attack Point
[*] Assault Rifle Tier 3 had a range of 60 instead of 15. Whoopsie poopsie.
[*] Boss Steve had a bit of an overbite, and could hit people inside Covered Attack Points. That's been fixed, and his attack range has been slightly nerfed.
[*] Armor was being ignored by weapons that lacked an Armor Penetration stat. This has been corrected, so the Assault Rifle is no longer the king of kings.
[*] Sometimes crew would stop firing for no apparent reason. Loren believes this to be fixed now, so cross your fingers and legs and everything else.
[*] Nick is a nerd
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.71 bug fixes & Boss rewards!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! A lot of things are coming in the following weeks, but here is the first set of improvements based on your feedback. Well, actually this is like the second? Or third? I'm not great at making these posts... So, in that spirit, thank you all for joining us on our flaming trainwreck adventure of gamedev!

As always, we welcome any and all feedback! 

If you want to see us working live, and get a sneak peak on the total map rework I'm doing now, hop over to our discord!

-Nick

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Added functionality:[/h3]
- Added reward for beating a boss, this reward can be a weapon, a resource bundle, an additional crew member, or an additional buildable blueprint!
- Kill Cam is a go! The last monster in a wave will trigger a sweet, sweet moment of victory. Revel in the death of your foes with a matrix-style throwback effect.

[h3]Added content:[/h3]
- Crossbow now has a cool visual effect when it fires
- New music! We continue to tweak the music with assistance from the community. Thanks to Pointyraccoon for the songs in this update. The original music, made by Kendal, has served us well and may resurface with some tweaks.
- End of wave UI now will have some dynamic text to give more character to the pilot. Hope you enjoy his messages that indicate upcoming supply drops.

[h3]Balancing changes[/h3]
- Increased cost, reduced durability, and reduced damage on the rifle turret (it was op as balls, let's be honest...)
- Increased cost and durability of Minigun. 


[h3]Bugfixes: [/h3]
- Multiple issues fixed on the Diner bathroom map, Bugs spawning inside objects on high waves, crew running outside the map to build things.
- Some steam achievements were missing graphics
- When building buildables, the other buildable popups don't occur anymore. No more accidentally breaking an existing buildable when making a new one!
- No longer need to hold Ctrl when rotating buildables. Just use mouse wheel. Incidentally, you can no longer zoom in and out via mouse wheel when building something. Duhhh.
- Character stat block scrolling now mouse wheels fine - grab and drag still works as before.
- Nick sucks balls.
